title: Aflibercept intravitreal injection: US label warnings
text: The US label for intravitreal aflibercept warns of endophthalmitis and retinal detachment after intravitreal injection, increases in intraocular pressure within 60 minutes of injection, and a potential risk of arterial thromboembolic events after intravitreal use of VEGF inhibitors. It is contraindicated in ocular or periocular infection and in active intraocular inflammation.

title: Brolucizumab intravitreal injection: US label warnings
text: The US label for brolucizumab warns of endophthalmitis and retinal detachment, and of retinal vasculitis and retinal vascular occlusion, typically in the presence of intraocular inflammation; patients with these events should stop treatment and be managed promptly. Intraocular pressure rises and arterial thromboembolic events are also listed.

title: Faricimab intravitreal injection: US label warnings
text: The US label for faricimab warns of endophthalmitis and retinal detachment after intravitreal injection, increases in intraocular pressure, and a potential risk of arterial thromboembolic events, and lists retinal vasculitis with or without occlusion. It is contraindicated in ocular or periocular infection, active intraocular inflammation and hypersensitivity.

title: Topiramate: US label warnings on acute myopia and secondary angle closure
text: The US label for topiramate warns of a syndrome of acute myopia associated with secondary angle closure glaucoma, usually within the first month of treatment, presenting with acute reduced vision and ocular pain. Treatment is to stop topiramate as rapidly as possible under the prescriber's judgement and to lower intraocular pressure.

title: Tamsulosin: US label warning on intraoperative floppy iris syndrome
text: The US label for tamsulosin warns that intraoperative floppy iris syndrome has been observed during cataract surgery in some patients treated with alpha one blockers. The surgeon should be told before surgery, because the syndrome may need changes to surgical technique, and the benefit of stopping the drug before surgery has not been established.

title: Dexamethasone intravitreal implant: US label warnings
text: The US label for the dexamethasone intravitreal implant lists contraindications including active or suspected ocular or periocular infection, advanced glaucoma, a torn or ruptured posterior lens capsule, and hypersensitivity. Warnings include endophthalmitis after injection, implant migration into the anterior chamber in eyes with a torn posterior capsule, and increased intraocular pressure and cataract with corticosteroid use.
